meta.name: muapi-animal-video-generator
meta.description: Create a hilarious and ultra-realistic video of an anthropomorphic animal acting like a human vlogger in a real-world setting.

copy.tagline: 生成拟人动物当网红博主的搞笑视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速生成拟人动物当网红的搞笑视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate hilarious videos of anthropomorphic animals acting as vloggers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly create funny videos of anthropomorphic animals acting as vloggers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以生成一只拟人动物（如猴子）在真实场景中像人类博主一样说话的视频，包括图像生成和唇形同步动画。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作动物博主视频，或提到“动物视频”、“搞笑猴子视频”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个猴子在印度诺伊达街头穿红T恤的博主视频。
say.note: Claude 会先创建图像，再生成带唇形同步的动画视频。

say.text: 做一只猫在东京街头穿蓝色夹克的vlog视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用你指定的动物、地点和服装生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a video of an anthropomorphic animal (e.g., monkey) acting like a human vlogger in a real-world setting, including image generation and lip-sync animation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create an animal vlogger video or mentions keywords like "animal video", "funny monkey video", etc.

say_en.text: Generate a monkey vlogger video in Noida, India, wearing a red t-shirt.
say_en.note: Claude will first create an image, then animate it with lip-sync.

say_en.text: Make a cat vlog video in Tokyo wearing a blue jacket.
say_en.note: Claude will use your specified animal, location, and clothing.
